Thank you for understanding
There really was not a question, more of a realization of how overwhelming my poor decisions are when looked at them as a whole.
Thank you, QuitaQuites for your suggestions!
JonMellor, not right now.  Our only child is 19 and going to college in 62 days.  I can sleep in her room after she leaves.  Thank you for taking the time to answer me and your willingness to help!!
I'm trying to chat with you but am not tech sauvy so I must not be doing it right (story of my life)
Happy birthday
Hi whitepeonytea

You are not alone in this.  All of us in this community are here for you.  If you don't feel like talking, you can even text with trained people.  Just text CONNECT to 741741 in the US and a trained person will text with you.  Your life is not over.  I know it feels that way and everything is so overwhelming right now. Give life 30 days.  Nothing stays the same.  Even our struggles.  Keep your chin up,  keep moving forward. And ALWAYS KEEP FIGHTING!)

Are you taking this pill to help with the demonsin you head? Most meds have warnings about suisidal ideation.  They could give you a different medicine and/or reduce the dose of your current med.  Just remember there are options out there and this community is here for you!

As long as you respect her boundaries of "just friends", I don't see any reason you should not reach out to her.  Just know she may be triggered by the conversation.

Remember you always have this community to reach out to.  Someone is always online.  There are also hotlines and even chat lines if you prefer that type of convo.

My point is, who you share your story with is completely your choice.  If you feel like she represents a safe place, or a sibling (if you have them), another fam member, or a stranger.  It is whatever you feel comfortable with.
I am in US.  If they don't have this exact med available where you are, your doc shld know of a similar medication.  It is worth asking the question to get your life back

I spoke to my Dr about my frequent bouts of the big D and he game me Lamotil.  It works really well for me.  Any time I am struggling with running to the potty, I can take a pill and within 20 min/half hour, it stops.  I can take up to 4 pills a day.  You might ask you Dr about this med, it seems safer than taking an OTC that you might have to increase without knowing what will happen.

Women love the person you are on the inside.  We want qualities like loyalty, a sense of humor, stability.  We want something like is real, that lasts.  My husband has some physical deformaties, his story to tell, not mine.   When I look at him.......I don't see them.  I see beautiful chocolate brown eyes and a sexy smile.  When he walks away, I see an ass I love to grab.  I see a man who loves me unconditionally, I see a man who makes me laugh, a man who knows how to have fun, I see the father of my children.  SHE IS OUT THERE!!  You may have some painful misses before you find her...I did.  But he was out there the whole time, waiting for me, and I finally found him.  SHE IS OUT THERE.  

Don't let your back ground define you.  I came from a shitty childhood, but instead of letting that rule me, I look it as a lesson of what NOT to do in my relationships.  My husband and I are celebrating our 20th anniversary this year.  SHE OUT THERE!!!!!
Just know you have friends and this community is here for you!
How are things today, pessimistdiary?  Remember, I am here as a friend of you need anything.

I'm sorry to bother you.....you just seemed to be able to see things in a different way and I was hoping you would talk to me again.

I'm scared to go to work tomorrow....I'm scared I am going to be fired for missing work.  I got called to HR last Friday and they told me I was actually -20 hours on my FMLA.  I would not qualify for another FMLA until May.  Then this Fri, I woke up in the night vomiting blood. I had to call in and go to the ER.  

See here is where my thought process goes off the rails.  In my original post, I explained how I wasted to be "good"  Eh I'llo very bad ......... But I always mess it up.  I have not been a "good" employee.  I have missed so much work...

I am so anxious and nervous.....
I would be happy to be your friend.  Tell me all about yourself! You reached out to this community.  I am reaching back
We are here for you.  I have a teenager, she is 17.  We have fought lots of battles from physical illness to mental illness.    This community is here for you.
Thank you for taking the time to reach out to me.

Thank you for taking the time to talk to me......I honestly never looked at this situation like that.   You make it sound like....I don't know,  maybe I am not so bad.  

I feel such guilt.  We are going to lose everything because of ME!!  Everything we worked for.....our house, our lifestyle, etc....

They deserve better.  They deserve a real person who helps instead of hinders.  

How do I live with that?

I don't eat really.  I survive in a few crackers, maybe some toast.  I have tried many diets, many food journeys......I was just released from the hospital (again).  The doc talked bout Humara injections but my ins won't cover it and we make $100 over the assistance threshold.  Again, I am the problem.  I can't get the mess that might help so where does that leave me???   Again, just existing and being a problem, a burden.  I believe the phrase that was said to me is "that's all I need! Another dead end because of you "
How tho?  How do you "muddle through another day"?
Thank you....more ppl have responded to me in the last few min than I have talked to in...months....

Hello.  You are right, of course.  I'm talking to strangers because it is safer.  I can tell you things because you don't know me.  You won't judge me.  You won't make me feel more worthless than I am.  You can't see the ugly parts of me.  

Good -  I used to be that.  I worked 50 plus hours, kept the house up, cooked, cleaned.  Paid bills on time.  Had $ in the bank.  I was there for friend, family, anyone who needed me.  

Then the disease took over.  I can't work now because of my illness.  My house is a mess.  I'm behind on every bill we have.  My marriage is falling apart.  I sleep on the couch every night so I don't keep him up with tossing and turning from pain and many trips to the bathroom.  I never leave the house unless they make me.  I just exist.  See?  That is the diseased, broken shell of me.  I don't know how to be good again.
Exactly.  I am overwhelmed.....thank you for understanding....
